notes: Coverage verified: all 29 source and all 36 target tokens partitioned exactly once.

The conjunction count balances: three waws against the ASV's three connectives (And, but, and), with the adversative but covered by rule 14's open list; the asyndetic מֵהָאֵשׁ יָצָאוּ clause has no conjunction morpheme and the ASV writes no connective for it, so rule 14's last clause has nothing to mark.

go forth keeps its head on go, since forth is a phrasal particle rather than a complement (rule 44); the verbless כִּי־אֲנִי יְהוָה clause gives I to the explicit pronoun and the supplied copula to the predicate (rule 20).
The temporal בְּ + infinitive is divided per rules 52 and 18: when on the preposition, set on the infinitive, I on its subject suffix.
